Built a polished dark ecommerce home page for "Northvale" with React-style components.

**Files created:**
- `index.html` — root document loading React 18 + Babel standalone
- `styles.css` — dark theme with accent green, responsive grid, motion-safe transitions
- `app.jsx` — React component tree

**Sections / components:**
- `PromoBar`, `Header` (sticky, with search, account, wishlist, bag with live counts)
- `Hero` with eyebrow, headline, CTAs, stats
- `Categories` (6-tile grid)
- `FeaturedProducts` with category tabs, ratings, wishlist toggle, add-to-bag
- `Deals` with live countdown timer + secondary/tertiary offer cards
- `Editorial` (3 article cards)
- `Newsletter` (validated form with live status)
- `Footer` with brand, socials, sitemap
- `ToastRegion` for ARIA-live add-to-bag confirmations

**Accessibility:** skip link, semantic landmarks (`header`/`main`/`nav`/`footer`/`section` with labels), `aria-current`, `aria-pressed` for wishlist, `aria-live` regions for toasts/countdown/newsletter status, visible focus rings, `sr-only` labels, `prefers-reduced-motion` honored, decorative images use `alt=""`.
